properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key for HS256 JWT signing. Must be at least 32 characters (256 bits).

properties.name: jwt.expiration-seconds
properties.description: Expiration duration in seconds for issued JWT tokens (default: 86400).

properties.name: app.default-user.username
properties.description: Default administrator username seeded on startup.

properties.name: app.default-user.password
properties.description: Default administrator password seeded on startup.

properties.name: app.default-user.role
properties.description: Default administrator role seeded on startup.
